topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture by framing the learning outcomes and connecting the content to prior histopathology practicals.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, oncogene discovery, and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical investigation of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays to measure oncogenic potential.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer mutations are functionally categorized and illustrate their mechanistic actions using cell cycle regulators and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sequential mutation accumulation drives tumor evolution and how inherited gene defects accelerate this multi-step pathway.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic reviews the lecture's completion against learning outcomes, provides recommended reading, and concludes the session.
